baseline.stdout:
usage: baton ACTION ARGS
Actions: inbox, read, send, report, ask, guide, finish, confirm, dispatch, players, assignment, status, role, ensemble, ensemble-member, section, section-member, orchestra, branch, knowledge.
Baton resolves your project and session. Successful native turns record handling of their complete owned reads. Use help ACTION for usage and explicit context options. Use help role for responsibilities, help ensemble for team coupling, help section for capability groups and help branch for alternatives, score-based selection and continuation.
dispatch TEXT [OPTIONS]
dispatch --stdin [OPTIONS]
dispatch --help shows project, saved routes, overrides and continuation options.
task-input-read --current returns the current actor's latest complete request and setup result.
task-input-read --session PLAYER selects that actor's latest dispatch to the Player.
Administration: baton DATABASE COMMAND ARGS
serve
owner-status
project PATH
project-sessions PATH
task-input-read --current | --session PLAYER
delivery MESSAGE_ID
delivery-batch IDS_JSON
message-batch SENDER MESSAGES_JSON
input MESSAGE_ID
turns PLAYER
ui-subscribe AFTER GENERATION
view SUBJECT [READER [PORT]]
logs-storage
logs-clean SESSION
project PATH registers this database in the project Git common directory. --project PATH selects the registered database.
delivery and input inspect an intentionally selected historical message. Native command forms remain available for existing integrations.
native-attachment-input SESSION COMPONENT initializes recorded external native guidance from complete stdin.

knowledge record --kind KIND --claim TEXT [--evidence TEXT] [--limits TEXT] [--links JSON]
knowledge search --query TEXT [--scope universal|worker|group|all] [--subject SUBJECT]
knowledge traverse --reference REFERENCE --direction in|out|both [--relation RELATION] [--recursive] [--scope universal|worker|group|all]
Baton resolves the author and generates finding and relation identities. Links contain source, relation and target evidence references. Kinds and relations are authored strings. Search matches all query terms across complete findings and retained evidence messages and returns typed neighbors with detail reads. Traversal follows scoped relations and terminates on cycles. Use help knowledge for the available actions.
